{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Dropping {qa_mask.sum()} QA orders with revenue 999999.99')

data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders — they are not revenue
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Dropping {refunded_mask.sum()} refunded orders')

data_clean = data_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Group by channel and compute total revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Display the totals
total_revenue_by_channel"}
